title: 第十四章  招摇山中
content_zh:
梓桑八旅的职责就是抵御外敌，守护一州平安。现在阳州的背嵬军没有出动，就充分说明了招摇城的情况。

    万风良一下山，就发现一个在附近晃悠的氏人斥候，沿途又发现几处鬼鬼祟祟的人影，等他靠近时，都各显神通，一个没有逮到，心里憋了一肚子气。

    正好看都这个羽人，二话没说，心中的怒气化成了无边的杀气。

    他对厌火和氏人的尸体查看了一番，没有什么有价值的发现，就继续朝招摇城赶去。

    寂静的丽麂水，被夜风撩过，月影随着波纹层层叠起。河边芳草罗生，树影杂乱，水寒月明，满目萧然。

    一队人影吵醒了夜的宁静，墨非夜众人正沿着河边，沿途寻找雨归尘口中的黑雾。厌火虽然会派出游骑在营地周边巡查，但是范围极小。众人毫无压力地穿过巡查区域后，就再无任何压力。

    “是这里吗？”这是墨攻行问的第5次，差不多每隔半个时辰他就会问一次。

    芊芊可能还处在深入敌后侦查的兴奋期，严守这墨非夜对他交代的，身为一名斥候的基本操守，一路上难得安静，只是警惕地看着前方。

    丽麂水沿河的风景都大同小异，无非就是杂草大树，所以雨归尘根本辨别不出，是不是当时看到黑雾的地方。众人只能继续朝前走，碰碰运气。

    在招摇山中，一头白色巨蛇在山中穿行。巨蛇那硕大的脑袋上站着一名手臂过膝的彪形大汉。

    “老大，真的在这里吗，已经转悠大半晚上了。”巨蛇口吐人言说道。

    大汉眉头一皱：“你来！”

    巨蛇吐了吐蛇信，不敢再言语。

    大汉跺了跺脚，脚下传来一阵巨响和巨蛇的哀嚎声，大汉说道：“很颠！”

    巨蛇抬起头，硬起脖子：“老大，下次你好好说行不行？”

    巨汉紧锁着眉头：“你来！”

    巨蛇加快扭动身体朝前滑去。

    “老六，你慢点，慢点，我要抓不住了”。勉强趴在蛇身上的斜眼男喊道。

    大汉回过头，紧锁着眉头说道：“你来。”

    一股绝望的神情到斜眼男的脸上，两只原本就斜的眼睛更加歪了，喊道：“老大！”

    “你来！”大汉的眉头抖动了一下。

    听到大汉的话，巨蛇尾巴一甩，将斜眼男从身上甩了下来，斜眼男滚到地上后，刚准备张口大骂，看到大汉的眉头又抖动了一下，将话吞回了肚子里。

    一股元气从斜眼男身上涌出，向他身体的各处蔓延，身体也随着元气的流动发生变化，身体被拉长，一条条小腿从身体两边长出，棕红色的硬壳在身体上浮现出现，一条五大的蜈蚣出现在巨蛇旁边。

    蜈蚣无比恭敬地伸直身体，抬起头，将脑袋靠在白蛇头旁边，大汉从白蛇头上走到蜈蚣头上，白蛇则迅速地萎缩缩成一团，最后变成一名水蛇腰的男人。

    水蛇腰扭着屁股，刚爬到蜈蚣的背上，蜈蚣报复式地扭动身体，让水蛇腰一阵颠簸。
content_en:
The duty of the Zisang Eighth Brigade is to resist foreign enemies and protect the peace of the state. Now that Yangzhou's Beiwei army has not dispatched, it fully illustrates the situation in Zhaoyao City.

    When Wan Fengliang got off the mountain, he found a clan scout wandering nearby. He also spotted several sneaky figures along the way. When he got closer, they all showed their special abilities. He couldn't catch any of them, and he felt very angry.

    He just happened to look at this feathered man, and without saying a word, the anger in his heart turned into boundless murderous intent.

    He checked the bodies of Yanhuo and Shiren, but found nothing valuable, so he continued to rush towards Zhaoyao City.

    The quiet Liji River was stirred by the night wind, and the moon shadows were layered with ripples. Fragrant grass grows along the river, the shadows of trees are messy, the water is cold and the moon is bright, and everything is desolate.

    A group of figures woke up the tranquility of the night. Mo Feiye and others were walking along the river, looking for the black mist in Yu Guichen's mouth. Although Fire-Tired will send out rangers to patrol around the camp, the scope is extremely small. After everyone passed through the inspection area without any pressure, they no longer felt any pressure.

    "Is this here?" This was the fifth time Mo Gengxing asked, and he would ask almost every half an hour.

    Qianqian was probably still in the excitement of conducting deep reconnaissance behind enemy lines. He strictly adhered to the basic ethics of being a scout as Mo Feiye told him. He was rarely quiet along the way and just looked ahead warily.

    The scenery along the Lilu River is similar, with nothing more than weeds and big trees, so Yu Guichen couldn't tell whether it was the place where he saw the black fog. Everyone could only continue to move forward and try their luck.

    In Swaggering Mountain, a giant white snake walks through the mountains. Standing on the giant snake's huge head was a burly man with arms above his knees.

    "Boss, are you really here? You have been wandering around for most of the night." The giant snake said human words.

    The big man frowned: "Come here!"

    The giant snake spit out the snake letter and did not dare to speak any more.

    The big man stamped his feet, and there was a loud noise and the wailing sound of the giant snake under his feet. The big man said: "It's very bumpy!"

    The giant snake raised its head and stiffened its neck: "Boss, can you please explain it carefully next time?"

    The giant man frowned: "Come here!"

    The giant snake twisted its body faster and slid forward.

    "Lao Liu, slow down, slow down, I won't be able to catch you." shouted the slant-eyed man who was reluctantly lying on the snake.

    The big man turned around, frowned and said, "Come here."

    A look of despair appeared on the slant-eyed man's face, and his two already slanted eyes became even more crooked, and he shouted: "Boss!"

    "Come here!" The big man's brows twitched.

    Hearing the big man's words, the giant snake flicked its tail and threw the slant-eyed man off his body. After the slant-eyed man rolled to the ground, he was about to open his mouth to curse when he saw the big man's brows twitching again and swallowed the words back in his stomach.

    A stream of vitality surged out of the slant-eyed man and spread to all parts of his body. The body also changed with the flow of vitality. The body was elongated, and legs grew out from both sides of the body. Brown-red hard shells appeared on the body, and a five-sized centipede appeared next to the giant snake.

    The centipede straightened its body with great respect, raised its head, and leaned its head next to the white snake's head. The big man walked from the white snake's head to the centipede's head. The white snake quickly shrank into a ball, and finally turned into a man with the waist of a water snake.

    The water snake twisted its buttocks and just climbed onto the centipede's back. The centipede twisted its body in retaliation, causing the water snake's waist to jolt.
